name: Lesson!! ~Katei Kyoushi Funtouki~
source:
Main character decides to work part-time as tutor while studying at university. But his first client has a rumor about him that his parents make poor tutors that child does not like to resign. Will protagonist meet harsh conditions by the end of the term or drop out from university? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
